independent_software.project: relax - NMR molecular dynamics analysis (Edward d'Auvergne et al)
independent_software.license_note: Original GPL software independently executed on authorized Yaksa desktop; no verbatim source code copied into Meta Registry; only numerical fixture and exact source provenance.
independent_software.source_calc: spectral_density_mf_orig() and relaxation_data(); physical magnetogyric constants in this reference differ slightly from JANUS due rounded published constants

parameters.protein: generic NH spin, not a predicted FN1-specific physical observable

independent_software.fixture_generation: Executed independently using original source file and NumPy on connected Yaksa (not copied from our own JANUS calculator); 3 separate proton frequencies and all five spectral densities included.

published_data.title: Rotational Diffusion Anisotropy of Human Ubiquitin from 15N NMR Relaxation
published_data.CRITICAL: This deposition has two sets PER observable, but BOTH are 600 MHz, so not real multi-field experimental validation. Original BMRB data are real published external control for magnitude/units and repeat-set consistency only.

sensitivity_prereg.approach: Compare additional axially symmetric rotational diffusion modes against exact isotropic counterpart; use fixed illustrative diffusion axis angle, not fitted to protein coordinates or data
sensitivity_prereg.amplitude_weights: A0=0.25*(3 cos(theta)^2-1)^2; A1=3 cos(theta)^2 sin(theta)^2; A2=0.75*sin(theta)^4
sensitivity_prereg.physical_requirement: A_m>=0 and sum=1; D_parallel/D_perp=1 must exactly recover isolated spherical case for all theta; relaxation rates computed with same R1 R2 NOE equations
sensitivity_prereg.expected_output: Finite grid absolute ranges for R1 R2 NOE and effect of CSA vs axial ratio; not inferred actual FN1 N-H axis orientation or diffusion tensor
